name: Gillguard
summary: A password field where a baby axolotl hatches and grows as your password gets stronger
about: A password strength meter with a pet: an egg sits in a little fish tank, and as your password gets stronger it hatches into an axolotl that grows, sprouts fluffy gills, gets spots and finally a crown. It watches the caret, covers its eyes when you show the password, and reacts to common words and runs like 123. A four-bar meter, a crack-time estimate and a rule list explain the score. Good for sign-up pages and account settings.
how: Type a password: the meter, the crack time and the rule list update with every key.
Each new level makes the creature squash, grow with a spring and burst out bubbles and stars; weaker passwords shrink it back.
Press the eye to show the password (the axolotl covers its eyes), the dice to type in a strong random password, or copy to copy it.
Confirm it and press Save: weak or mismatched passwords shake the card and explain why; a good one shows Saving, then Saved with a cheer.
Press the button again to clear the form; the creature curls back into its egg. Reduced motion keeps every state without the big movement.
